1: # M5 Extended-20 Portfolio Approval
2: 
3: Status: **APPROVED FOR FORMALIZATION — REVIEW-REFINED PRIMARY 20 FROZEN; FORMAL RUNS WAIT FOR M5.2 ANCHOR**

13: ## 1. Independent review verdict
14: 
15: The selection methodology is accepted. It satisfies the intended anti-cherry-picking design:
16: 
17: - all 52 locally available candidates were inventoried;
18: - Paper-10 direct duplicates and microbenchmarks were excluded;
19: - no PAPER_IO/PAPER_OO/DTC benefit data was used in selection;
20: - source/Base-only pressure, operation mix, domain diversity and historical cost were used instead;
21: - irregular, structured, reuse-heavy, reduction/search, write/atomic and compute-heavy controls are represented.
22: 
23: One **pre-performance portfolio refinement** is made during independent review:
24: 
25: - replace selected PolyBench `3mm` with alternate Rodinia `lud`.
26: 
27: Reason: the purpose of Extended-20 is to broaden coverage beyond Paper-10. Paper-10 already contains `2mm`; `3mm` is source-valid but remains a closely related chained dense-matrix family and is historical Q4 cost. `lud` provides a more distinct blocked LU/factorization/update behavior while preserving dense/reuse-heavy compute coverage. This decision is made before any Extended DTC performance is observed.
28: 
29: After the refinement the suite mix is:
30: 
31: - CUDA SDK: 8
32: - Rodinia: 6
33: - Parboil: 6
34: 
35: This still satisfies the original >=3-suite and <=50%-single-suite portfolio constraint. The pressure mix remains within the intended high/medium/low balance, and the Q4 count is reduced by removing `3mm`.
36: 
37: The portfolio is therefore suitable as a **supplemental generalization set**, not a replacement for the thesis Paper-10.
38:

75: 
76: A second review correction applies to CUDA SDK `BlackScholes`:
77: 
78: - use algorithm name `Black-Scholes option pricing`;
79: - do not label it `Monte Carlo option pricing` unless the recovered source explicitly implements Monte Carlo sampling;

81: - retain its role as a compute-heavy/low-memory-pressure control only if source/Base evidence supports that classification during E1.

86: 
87: The historical selection evidence is trace/roster anchored. Before each workload enters M5.E2 FORMAL runs, M5.E1 must freeze:

90: - source path and wrapper/build command;
91: - executable and PTX SHA-256;
92: - canonical/deterministic input path and byte SHA-256;
93: - output checker/reference and reference hash;
94: - launch geometry/work amount;
95: - M5 Core SHA;
96: - M5 Framework SHA;
97: - Base/IO/OO config hashes;
98: - parser/schema identity.
99: 
100: Historical L2 trace completion is evidence of prior runnability only. It is not an M5 performance result.
101: 
102: If exact source/input recovery materially changes workload identity, re-evaluate E1-E8 eligibility and portfolio constraints before formal launch.

105:

107: 
108: - `PAPER_10` / `GM-PAPER10`: original ten thesis compute workloads;
109: - `EXTENDED_20` / `GM-EXTENDED20`: this review-refined supplemental set;
110: - `ALL_COMPUTE_30` / `GM-ALL-COMPUTE30`: union, supplemental generalization view only.
111: 
112: Do not merge Extended-20 into thesis Figure 4.x aggregate labels or `GM-ALL-PAPER`.

115:

117:
